name: ASG Stable Coin
calculation_note_hr: Indikativna referentna vrijednost 1 ASG izračunava se kao 1/100 tržišne vrijednosti 1 kg zlata, prema cijeni zlata prikazanoj u tržišnom monitoru.
calculation_note_en: The indicative reference value of 1 ASG is calculated as 1/100 of the market value of 1 kg of gold, based on the gold price shown in the market monitor.
disclaimer_hr: Konceptualni informativni prikaz. Ovaj portal ne potvrđuje izdanje tokena, postojanje zlatnih rezervi, regulatorno odobrenje, mogućnost kupnje ili ponudu ulaganja.
disclaimer_en: Conceptual informational display. This portal does not confirm token issuance, existence of gold reserves, regulatory authorisation, purchase availability or an investment offering.
